items.title: Entity spans must remain inside source bounds
recommendedNonProviderNextWork: Add offline boundary-property tests for negative, empty and Unicode spans.
Make the adapter reject or classify out-of-source spans before materialization without persisting raw text.
acceptanceCriteria: Every accepted span satisfies 0 <= start <= end <= source code-point length.
Malformed spans produce a finite fail-closed diagnostic and cannot enter scoring or persistence.
The diagnostic report reconciles one-to-one with immutable case records.
deferredUntil: new exact lineage and authorization if a provider rerun is ever proposed
reopenConditions: A new owner decision explicitly reopens provider experimentation after offline contract evidence passes

items.title: Evidence must contain the trigger and both relation endpoints
recommendedNonProviderNextWork: Keep trigger and endpoint containment as separate finite materializer predicates.
Add deterministic Unicode/code-point and clause/sentence boundary fixtures for missing, outside and non-containing evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: A relation is exact only when one evidence span contains the trigger and both resolved endpoints.
Trigger and endpoint failure counts reconcile to the same exact semantic-pair denominator.
Gold-relations control remains zero-invalid under every fixture mutation.
deferredUntil: raw payload/source custody if exact provider causality is requested
reopenConditions: A new preregistered hypothesis defines a measurable evidence-containment change and receives separate owner authorization

items.title: Scorer, materializer and accounting contracts must be immutable

measuredEvidence.rm50: Coordinated mutations to providerCallsAttempted, responsesReceived, pricedCalls, usageValidResponses, totalCostUsd, costCeilingUsd and hard-failure classes remain accepted.

recommendedNonProviderNextWork: Derive all accounting and gate totals from immutable source case records and execution facts.
Add mutation tests that independently alter calls, responses, pricing, usage, cost and hard-failure accounting.
Quarantine RM-50 as rejected evidence; do not patch or relabel it in this closure track.
acceptanceCriteria: Any accounting mutation fails before a pass, reconciliation or promotion claim.
Unknown v8 cost and incomplete accounting remain null/unknown, never coerced to zero.
A fresh artifact binds source digests, case identity and derived totals without raw payloads.
deferredUntil: new owner decision outside this closed track
reopenConditions: Owner explicitly opens a new accounting-contract workstream with a complete immutable contract

items.title: Prompt/model/provider behavior remains unknown

measuredEvidence.causalAttribution: not established because raw provider payload/source is not retained

recommendedNonProviderNextWork: Do not infer prompt or model causality from aggregate sanitized counts; document the unknown boundary.
acceptanceCriteria: Any causal claim requires newly authorized, immutable and privacy-approved evidence that actually observes the relevant payload/source.
deferredUntil: external custody and a new owner-authorized experiment
reopenConditions: New owner decision with a measurable hypothesis, exact lineage and approved payload/source custody

items.title: Windows Git-blob custody must be explicit

measuredEvidence.lesson: Working-tree CRLF bytes and canonical Git-blob LF bytes can differ while remaining content-equivalent.
measuredEvidence.custodyRule: Bind exact-commit Git blobs and record any working-tree normalization as a separate reconciliation.

recommendedNonProviderNextWork: Make safe tests calculate both index/blob and working-tree digests where exact-commit custody is claimed.
acceptanceCriteria: A claimed exact-commit digest is independently reproducible from git show and cannot be satisfied by an untracked working-tree rewrite.
reopenConditions: Any future exact-lineage preparation or custody mismatch

items.title: Unsafe historical tests must not delete immutable reports

measuredEvidence.lesson: Some historical mock tests can remove the immutable Stage A report when run against the repository output path.
measuredEvidence.requiredControl: Run destructive-path tests only against disposable copies and keep safe suites read-only against v6/v9.

recommendedNonProviderNextWork: Mark destructive tests unsafe, redirect outputs to temporary directories and add a report-presence custody assertion.
acceptanceCriteria: Safe regression tests leave v6/v9 bytes and digests unchanged and preserve absent v8 output.
reopenConditions: Any test or script proposes writing to an immutable report path

items.title: G6 held-out and human evidence remain external blockers

measuredEvidence.repositoryState: held-out payload and gold are not present; humanEvidence remains false

recommendedNonProviderNextWork: Coordinate only with an authorized external custodian; do not synthesize or relabel repository fixtures as held-out evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Custody, unlock, blinded evaluation, reviewer evidence and digests are independently recorded under a later owner gate.
reopenConditions: Human owner supplies an authorized external custody transition

claimBoundary: Prioritized offline backlog only. It records failures, unknowns and custody lessons; it does not claim Sprint 12, G5 or G6 completion or quality.
